overall_assessment: The module implements a small SQLite-backed retrieval factory with reasonable shape but a few sharp edges around connection lifecycle and retry control. Core path is correct.

findings.title: Connection leak on rollback
findings.issue: rollback_transaction does not close the cursor before returning the connection to the pool.
findings.why: Open cursors keep the underlying file descriptor pinned; under load the pool exhausts and audits stall.
findings.fix: Close the cursor in a finally block before returning the connection.

findings.title: Race between writer and snapshot reader
findings.issue: Writer commits a row that snapshot reader can observe mid-batch.
findings.why: Snapshot must be a consistent prefix; partial visibility breaks downstream invariants.
findings.fix: Wrap the batch in a transaction and let the reader use the same isolation snapshot.

findings.title: Unbounded retry loop on stale | index
findings.issue: While loop has no max_iterations cap.
findings.why: Pensiv discipline requires every external loop to declare a bound.
findings.fix: Add max_iterations=10 and raise on overflow.

findings.title: Module docstring anchors back to spec
findings.issue: The module docstring references the relevant spec section, matching project convention.
findings.why: This makes it easy for new readers to find the contract this module implements.

recommendations.title: Use a context manager for cursors
recommendations.rationale: Eliminates the leak class entirely; cursors close deterministically on exit.
recommendations.code_snippet:
with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute(sql)
    rows = cur.fetchall()

recommendations.title: Document the snapshot isolation level
recommendations.rationale: Readers need to know which isolation level the writer expects so partial-visibility regressions are caught in code review.
